receiptImpact: The immutable registry release publishes the exact InterAI D8 EconomicEvidenceCommitment EIP-712 descriptor and an explicit experimental-only admission. OracleSafetyCheck v3 remains its exact existing 27-field signed layout; existing attester keys, all partner policies, activation set v6, Stage 2 policy, execution behavior, and production decision authority remain unchanged. No companion issuance path is enabled by this promotion.
activationRule: The D8 companion may not be signed or treated as decision authority merely because this descriptor is published. Any future D8 capture requires bilateral domain acceptance, an independently pinned current registry body and active attester validity window, D8-03 pre-capture verification, a positive companion window contained by both v3 evidences and the quote at evaluation time, and experiment-plus-input UID replay protection. This promotion grants no capture, /verify, execution, broadcast, or Stage 2 change.
